attr.title: Rejuvenation V14
attr.desc: Rejuvenation V14 is a free fan game by the Rejuvenation team, set in the Aevium region. This port runs it on aarch64 handhelds with the mkxp-z engine the game ships with on PC. The game files are not included; download them from the developers.
attr.inst: Download V14 (Linux or Windows) from https://www.rebornevo.com/rejuvdown/ and copy everything inside it into ports/rejuvenation14/game/. Requires ROCKNIX on a device running Sway (Wayland) with desktop OpenGL; tested on the AYN Odin 2 with 14.0.24. The in-game updater works.
